{
  "jobspec": "#!/bin/bash

# Flux batch script
#
# NOTE: This PBS script requests a large allocation:
#   select=20:ncpus=28  (20 nodes, 28 cores/node) and runs mpiexec -n 560.
# We translate that to Flux as 20 nodes and 560 ranks.

# Translated resources from PBS:
#   -l select=20:ncpus=28  -> -N 20 and (best-effort) -n 560
#   -l walltime=15:00:00   -> -t 15h
JOBID=$(flux batch -N 20 -n 560 -t 15h --wrap "bash $0 __flux_inner")

echo "Submitted Flux job: $JOBID"

if [ "${1:-}" = "__flux_inner" ]; then
  # NOTE: PBS -W group_list=cosmo not translated.
  # Performance/ops implication: group/accounting/authorization controls may differ; site policy may require this out-of-band.

  # NOTE: PBS -q qualified not translated.
  # Performance implication: without a queue/constraint mapping, the job may run on any eligible resources; you are not forcing the qualified queue.

  # NOTE: PBS -l mem=168GB (per node) and/or pcmem not translated.
  # Performance implication: without a memory reservation/limit, the job may contend for memory or be OOM-killed.

  # NOTE: PBS -l place=free:shared not translated.
  # Performance implication: placement and node-sharing behavior may differ, affecting performance.

  # NOTE: PBS -l cput=... not translated.
  # Performance implication: CPU-time enforcement may differ.

  # NOTE: PBS -e/-o directories not translated.
  # Performance implication: none; operational implication: stdout/stderr routing follows Flux defaults unless configured.

  # PBS_O_WORKDIR is PBS-specific; use current directory.
  cd "${PWD}" || exit 1

  module load python/2
  module load mpich/ge/gcc/64/3.2.1
  module load openmpi

  export MPI_DSM_DISTRIBUTE

  date
  # Prefer Flux for rank launch within the allocation.
  flux run -n 560 /usr/bin/time python runWFIRST_3x2pt_allsys_pessi_MG.py
  date
fi
"
}
